% hmm: ported to ProbLog from PluckArtifact.jl/src/table1/sequence_models/
% pluck/hmm.jl of the artifact of Bowers, Lew, Tenenbaum, Solar-Lezama and
% Mansinghka, "Stochastic Lazy Knowledge Compilation for Inference in
% Discrete Probabilistic Programs" (PLDI 2025), Zenodo
% 10.5281/zenodo.15051140 (CC-BY-4.0): the Pluck program of the paper's
% Table 1, row HMM. The query is the probability that the first 50
% emissions are all true, of the chain
%   hmm z0 = let z1 = flip (if z0 then 0.7 else 0.1)
%            in Cons (flip (if z1 then 0.3 else 0.6)) (hmm z1)
% from z0 false. z(T) is the state after step T, x(T) its emission, and
% seen(T) that the first T emissions are true.
steps(50).
step(T) :- steps(N), between(1, N, T).

0.7::stays(T) :- step(T).
0.1::rises(T) :- step(T).
0.3::shows_on(T) :- step(T).
0.6::shows_off(T) :- step(T).

z(T) :- step(T), P is T - 1, z(P), stays(T).
z(T) :- step(T), P is T - 1, \+z(P), rises(T).
x(T) :- z(T), shows_on(T).
x(T) :- step(T), \+z(T), shows_off(T).
seen(0).
seen(T) :- step(T), P is T - 1, seen(P), x(T).

emitted :- steps(N), seen(N).
query(emitted).

:- pita.
:- begin_lpad.
:- table seen/1.
:- table z/1.
steps(50).
step(T) :- steps(N), between(1, N, T).
stays(T):0.7 :- step(T).
rises(T):0.1 :- step(T).
shows_on(T):0.3 :- step(T).
shows_off(T):0.6 :- step(T).
z(T) :- step(T), P is T - 1, z(P), stays(T).
z(T) :- step(T), P is T - 1, \+z(P), rises(T).
x(T) :- z(T), shows_on(T).
x(T) :- step(T), \+z(T), shows_off(T).
seen(0).

emitted :- steps(N), seen(N).
:- end_lpad.
main :-
    forall((Q = emitted, prob(Q, P)), (term_to_atom(Q, Q0), atomic_list_concat(Qs, 'problog2pita_', Q0), atomic_list_concat(Qs, Q1), format("~w:\t~w~n", [Q1, P]))).

# pluck_hmm.dice, translated by tddlog's scripts/dice2sppl.py.
# component 0 bool s1_1[50] 0,1
s1_0 = array(51)
s1_1 = array(51)
v14 = array(50)
v12 = array(50)
v13 = array(50)
v17 = array(50)
v15 = array(50)
v16 = array(50)
v18 = array(50)
s1_0[0] ~= atomic(loc=0)
s1_1[0] ~= atomic(loc=1)
for i1_ in range(50):
    if (s1_0[i1_] << {1}):
        v12[i1_] ~= bernoulli(p=0.7)
        v14[i1_] ~= v12[i1_]
        v13[i1_] ~= atomic(loc=0)
    else:
        v13[i1_] ~= bernoulli(p=0.1)
        v14[i1_] ~= v13[i1_]
        v12[i1_] ~= atomic(loc=0)
    if (v14[i1_] << {1}):
        v15[i1_] ~= bernoulli(p=0.3)
        v17[i1_] ~= v15[i1_]
        v16[i1_] ~= atomic(loc=0)
    else:
        v16[i1_] ~= bernoulli(p=0.6)
        v17[i1_] ~= v16[i1_]
        v15[i1_] ~= atomic(loc=0)
    if (s1_1[i1_] << {1}) & (v17[i1_] << {1}):
        v18[i1_] ~= atomic(loc=1)
    else:
        v18[i1_] ~= atomic(loc=0)
    s1_0[i1_ + 1] ~= v14[i1_]
    s1_1[i1_ + 1] ~= v18[i1_]

#lang roulette/example/disrupt
;; pluck_hmm.dice, translated by tddlog's scripts/dice2roulette.py.

(require racket/port racket/string)

;; A statement of the program: a definition, which the language does not
;; run as a query of its own (it runs each expression of the module as one).
(define-syntax-rule (statement e ...) (define-values () (begin e ... (values))))

;; Integers: lists of Booleans, least significant bit first.
(define (bxor a b) (! (<=> a b)))
(define (bv-add xs ys [c #f])
  (if (null? xs)
      '()
      (let* ([x (car xs)] [y (car ys)] [s (bxor x y)])
        (cons (bxor s c) (bv-add (cdr xs) (cdr ys) (|| (&& x y) (&& c s)))))))
(define (bv-sub xs ys) (bv-add xs (map ! ys) #t))
(define (bv-mul xs ys)
  (define w (length xs))
  (for/fold ([acc (make-list w #f)]) ([y (in-list ys)] [i (in-naturals)])
    (if (eq? y #f)
        acc
        (bv-add acc (append (make-list i #f) (for/list ([x (in-list (take xs (- w i)))]) (&& y x)))))))
(define (bv-eq xs ys) (apply && (map <=> xs ys)))
(define (bv-ult xs ys)
  (for/fold ([lt #f]) ([x (in-list xs)] [y (in-list ys)])
    (|| (&& (! x) y) (&& (<=> x y) lt))))
(define (bv-shl xs k)
  (define w (length xs))
  (take (append (make-list (min k w) #f) xs) w))
(define (bv-shr xs k)
  (define j (min k (length xs)))
  (append (drop xs j) (make-list j #f)))

;; Dice's categorical (gen_discrete): from the most significant bit down,
;; bit k is a flip whose probability is the mass of the values with bit k
;; set among those that agree on the bits above, over their mass; one flip
;; for each distinct ratio, chosen by the bits above, settings of no mass
;; left out.
(define (discrete w ps)
  (define size (expt 2 w))
  (define given (list->vector ps))
  (define masses
    (for/vector ([i (in-range size)])
      (if (< i (vector-length given)) (inexact->exact (vector-ref given i)) 0)))
  (define (mass lo hi) (for/sum ([i (in-range lo hi)]) (vector-ref masses i)))
  (let level ([k (sub1 w)] [above '()])
    (cond
      [(< k 0) (reverse above)]
      [else
       (define span (expt 2 (add1 k)))
       (define flips (make-hash))
       (define table
         (for/vector ([u (in-range (quotient size span))])
           (define lo (* u span))
           (define total (mass lo (+ lo span)))
           (cond
             [(zero? total) 'none]
             [else
              (define r (exact->inexact (/ (mass (+ lo (quotient span 2)) (+ lo span)) total)))
              (hash-ref! flips r (λ () (cond [(= r 0) #f] [(= r 1) #t] [else (flip r)])))])))
       (level (sub1 k) (append above (list (choose above table))))])))
;; The entry of table for the setting of the bits `above` (most significant
;; first), constant where every setting of mass agrees.
(define (choose above table)
  (define vals (for/list ([x (in-vector table)] #:unless (eq? x 'none)) x))
  (cond
    [(null? vals) #f]
    [(andmap (λ (x) (eq? x (car vals))) vals) (car vals)]
    [else
     (define half (quotient (vector-length table) 2))
     (if (car above)
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table half))
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table 0 half)))]))
(define (uniform w lo hi)
  (discrete w (for/list ([i (in-range hi)]) (if (< i lo) 0.0 (exact->inexact (/ 1 (- hi lo)))))))

(define (bits->natural bs)
  (for/sum ([b (in-list bs)] [i (in-naturals)]) (if b (expt 2 i) 0)))
(define (real p) (if (exact? p) (exact->inexact p) p))
;; Racket's `time` around the program's statements and its queries.
(define (start-clock)
  (vector (current-process-milliseconds) (current-inexact-milliseconds) (current-gc-milliseconds)))
(define (print-time c)
  (printf "cpu time: ~a real time: ~a gc time: ~a\n"
          (- (current-process-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 0))
          (inexact->exact (round (- (current-inexact-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 1))))
          (- (current-gc-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 2))))

;; The distribution of v, a list of (value . probability): Roulette's query
;; at the module's level (`display-pmf`), read back from the table it
;; prints, or from the one value it prints alone.
(define (distribution v)
  (define text (with-output-to-string (λ () (display-pmf v))))
  (define (datum s)
    (define d (read (open-input-string s)))
    (if (and (pair? d) (eq? (car d) 'quote)) (cadr d) d))
  (define rows
    (for/list ([line (in-list (string-split text "\n"))]
               #:when (regexp-match? #rx"[│|]" line))
      (filter (λ (s) (not (string=? s ""))) (map string-trim (regexp-split #rx"[│|]" line)))))
  (if (null? rows)
      (list (cons (datum text) 1))
      (for/list ([r (in-list rows)]
                 #:unless (equal? r '("Value" "Probability")))
        (cons (datum (car r)) (string->number (cadr r))))))
;; (Not cond's `=>`: the language binds `=>` to Rosette's implication.)
(define (probability dist v)
  (define e (assoc v dist))
  (if e (cdr e) 0))
(define (report-bool k dist)
  (printf "roulette ~a true ~a\n" k (real (probability dist #t)))
  (printf "roulette ~a false ~a\n" k (real (probability dist #f))))
(define (report-int k dist w)
  (define by-value (make-hash))
  (for ([vp (in-list dist)])
    (hash-set! by-value (bits->natural (car vp)) (cdr vp)))
  (for ([i (in-range (expt 2 w))])
    (printf "roulette ~a ~a ~a\n" k i (real (hash-ref by-value i 0)))))

(define (f-step x1-s)
  (define x2-z (car x1-s))
  (define x3-seen (cadr x1-s))
  (define x6-next (if x2-z (let ()
  (define x4-next (flip 0.7))
  x4-next) (let ()
  (define x5-next (flip 0.1))
  x5-next)))
  (define x9-shown (if x6-next (let ()
  (define x7-shown (flip 0.3))
  x7-shown) (let ()
  (define x8-shown (flip 0.6))
  x8-shown)))
  (define x10-step (list x6-next (&& x3-seen x9-shown)))
  x10-step)

(define clock (start-clock))
(define x11-result (list #f #t))
(define x13-result (for/fold ([x12-state x11-result]) ([_ (in-range 50)]) (f-step x12-state)))
(define x14-result (cadr x13-result))
(define dists (list (distribution x14-result)))
(statement (print-time clock))
(statement (report-bool 1 (list-ref dists 0)))

function hmm_defs()

  @define "hmm" """
  (Y (λ rec z0 -> 
    (let (z1 (flip (if z0 0.7 0.1)))   
      (Cons (flip (if z1 0.3 0.6)) (rec z1)))))
  """

  @define "prefix_equals?" """
  (Y (λ rec xs ys -> 
    (case ys of Nil => true | 
                Cons yhd ytl => (case xs of Nil => false | 
                                            Cons xhd xtl => (and (constructors_equal xhd yhd) (rec xtl ytl))))))
  """

  @define "prefix_equals_smc?" """
  (Y (λ rec xs ys -> 
    (case ys of Nil => (FinallyTrue) | 
        Cons yhd ytl => (case xs of Nil => (FinallyFalse) | 
              Cons xhd xtl => (if (constructors_equal xhd yhd) (Suspend (rec xtl ytl)) (FinallyFalse))))))
  """

  @define "generate_observations" "(Y (λ rec n -> (case n of O => (Nil) | S => (λ npred -> (Cons (True) (rec npred))))))"

  @define "hmm_example" "(λ n -> (prefix_equals? (hmm (False)) (generate_observations n)))"
  @define "hmm_example_smc" "(λ n -> (prefix_equals_smc? (hmm (False)) (generate_observations n)))"
end

# hmm: the Pluck program PluckArtifact.jl/src/table1/sequence_models/pluck/
# hmm.jl of the artifact of Bowers et al., "Stochastic Lazy Knowledge
# Compilation for Inference in Discrete Probabilistic Programs" (PLDI
# 2025), Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15051140 (CC-BY-4.0), the paper's Table 1,
# row HMM, in the Dice.jl form the artifact gives it as a baseline,
# sequence_models/dice/hmm.jl: the same model, its 50 emissions generated
# and compared with 50 trues. Ported from that file. Mechanical port:
# Dice.List, Dice.Nil and Dice.Cons -> Alea's List, Nil and Cons,
# @dice_ite -> @alea_ite, the add_benchmark! harness dropped, `pr(E)` ->
# E, the query moved to QUERY and model().
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr


function dice_hmm_example(N)

    function make_bool_list(n)
        n == 0 && return Nil(AnyBool)
        Cons(AnyBool, true, make_bool_list(n-1))
    end

    function hmm(z0, num_steps)

        if num_steps == 0
            return Nil(AnyBool)
        end

        z1 = @alea_ite if z0 
            flip(0.7)
        else
            flip(0.1)
        end

        x1 = @alea_ite if z1 
            flip(0.3)
        else
            flip(0.6)
        end

        return Cons(AnyBool, x1, hmm(z1, num_steps - 1))
    end
        
    function bool_lists_equal(l1::List{AnyBool}, l2::List{AnyBool})
        match(l1, [:Nil => () -> match(l2, [:Nil => () -> true, :Cons => (hd, tl) -> false]), :Cons => (x, xs) -> match(l2, [:Cons => (y, ys) -> (@alea_ite if (prob_equals(x, y)); bool_lists_equal(xs, ys); else; false; end), :Nil => () -> false])])
    end 

    return bool_lists_equal(hmm(false, N), make_bool_list(N))
end

model() = dice_hmm_example(50)
